You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-selling-digital-products-africa-serious|The Complete]]s. But for millions of creators, the payment layer is where everything breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Gumroad's 10% fees are nothing compared to the financial isolation that comes with relying on traditional payment platforms. Your customers are increasingly turning to cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, which NOWPayments processes with a mere 0.5% fee. By deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can tap into this lucrative market and reap the benefits of low fees, instant payment processing, and complete infrastructural control.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need to set up a few essential components. These include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments will be used for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, allowing you to process Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies with ease.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, start by integrating NOWPayments with your chosen payment method. This will enable automatic on-chain crypto payment verification and instant payment processing. Next, configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle backend logic and automate the delivery of your digital products. Finally, set up Supabase or Google Sheets to store orders and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery.
Deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack can save you up to 99.5% in fees compared to traditional payment platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, it's time to go live. Process your first transaction by sending a test payment to your NOWPayments wallet. This will trigger automatic on-chain crypto payment verification and ensure that your infrastructure is functioning correctly. Verify that your digital product is being delivered correctly and that orders are being stored in Supabase or Google Sheets.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling your sovereign digital commerce stack is a straightforward process. As your sales increase, simply purchase more instances of your infrastructure components, such as Cloudflare Pages or Google Drive, to handle the additional traffic. Use the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, allowing you to build, deploy, and scale a highly customized digital commerce stack that meets your unique needs.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
With NOWPayments, you can process Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies with ease and security.

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, you're not alone. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can join the growing ranks of entrepreneurs who are taking control of their payment infrastructure and reaping the rewards of low fees, instant payment processing, and complete infrastructural control. And with the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at your fingertips, you can build, deploy, and scale a highly customized digital commerce stack that meets your unique needs. Ready to get started? Shop our products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack for your ebook sales, follow these concrete steps: Set up GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting and configure your domain name. Integrate NOWPayments with your chosen payment method and configure automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle backend logic and automate digital product delivery. Configure Supabase or Google Sheets to store orders and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Process your first transaction and verify that your infrastructure is functioning correctly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I process Bitcoin payments with NOWPayments?

Simply integrate NOWPayments with your chosen payment method and configure automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This will enable instant payment processing and secure, frictionless transactions for your customers.
Can I use a different payment method besides NOWPayments?
Yes, you can use other payment methods, but NOWPayments offers the lowest fees and most secure transactions, making it the ideal choice for your sovereign digital commerce stack.
Do I need to store customer information with my sovereign digital commerce stack?
No, because NOWPayments' zero-KYC policy ensures that every transaction is secure, fast, and completely frictionless for your customers.
How do I configure automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with NOWPayments?

Integrate NOWPayments with your chosen payment method and configure automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This will enable instant payment processing and secure, frictionless transactions for your customers.
Can I use my sovereign digital commerce stack to sell other types of digital products?
Yes, your sovereign digital commerce stack is highly customizable and can be used to sell a wide range of digital products, from ebooks and courses to templates and software.
Your customers will never have to create an account or provide sensitive information to make a payment with your sovereign digital commerce stack.
